title: One-minute claims and manager scripts
content:
Purpose:
Quick, skimmable bank of one-line claims + supporting evidence and short scripts I can use in 1:1s, calibration, and promotion conversations. Designed for rapid rehearse and last-minute sync before manager meetings.

TL;DR (use as opener):
- "I shipped a cross-functional onboarding redesign that cut first-week setup time by ~40% and reduced escalations by half — I want to align on next steps and what I’d need to own to scale it org-wide."

Top claims (one-liners + evidence pointer):
1) Reduced first-week setup time by ~40% (measured from cohort analysis, cohort = new hires Q2–Q4 2025). Evidence: onboarding-timings-sheet (linked above), customer quotes in onboarding-feedback doc.
2) Cut escalations for new-hire accesses from 12% -> 6% (tracked in SRE tickets; P0s reduced). Evidence: JIRA-3421 ticket trend export.
3) Built a lightweight onboarding kit that saved ~2.5 hours per hiring manager (pilot with 8 managers). Evidence: pilot-survey-2025Q3 results, manager quotes in Slack.
4) Improved new hire time-to-first-meaningful-PR from 18 days -> 12 days in pilot cohort. Evidence: git-winboard csv + onboarding cohort mapping.
5) Led cross-team rollout with Eng + Infra + DX; no rollback incidents, 3-week rapid rollout. Evidence: rollout-runbook-v1, postmortem notes (no sev>1).
6) Mentored two new ICs to full onboarding ownership (they are now onboarding leads). Evidence: 1:1 notes and handoff checklist.

Quick scripts (30–90s) — adaptable language, choose friendly or firm tone: 
- Friendly opener: "I wanted to share a quick update on the onboarding work — pilot metrics are promising (setup time down ~40%, escalations halved). I’m thinking about how to make this the default for the next 3 cohorts and wanted your view on where to prioritize my bandwidth."
- Direct ask: "I’d like sponsorship to own the org-wide rollout and a small budget for contract design help — estimated 4w agency + 0.2 FTE project support. If that’s not viable, my fallback is to scope a lighter automation-only rollout that keeps the same owner model."
- Calibration / promotion framing: "Beyond the project metrics, I’ve been driving cross-team alignment and building operational playbooks that other teams can reuse — that’s a pattern I’d like to scale and be recognized for as part of my scope growth."
- If manager pushes back on time: "Totally get constraints — what would you prioritize: (A) org rollout with limited budget, (B) deeper automation but narrower scope, or (C) handoff and documentation so others can pick it up? I can map next steps to the option you pick."

Evidence snippets to paste quickly into chat (1-line each):
- "Pilot cut first-week setup time by ~40% — see cohort timings and pilot survey (confluence link)."
- "Escalations dropped 50% (SRE ticket export attached)."
- "Two ICs now running onboarding for their pods — handoff checklist and direct quotes available."

Quick scoreboard (metrics I want on the manager dashboard):
- Mean first-week setup time: 2.8 days (target <3.5)
- Escalation rate: 6% (was 12%)
- Time-to-first-meaningful-PR: 12 days (pilot)
- Hiring manager satisfaction (Likert): 4.5/5 pilot
- Estimated hours saved per hire: ~2.5

Progress against personal goals (quarterly):
- Goal: Expand scope from ‘onboarding product’ to ‘onboarding platform’ (owner-level change). Progress: completed pilot, documented runbook, aligned Infra; ask: sponsor to own org rollout to formalize scope.
- Goal: Demonstrate cross-functional leadership. Progress: ran 3 working sessions with Eng/Infra/DX; evidence: meeting notes + acceptance of runbook.
- Goal: Mentorship & people growth. Progress: two mentees promoted to onboarding leads; next: formal mentor plan + 1:1 curriculum.

Open risks / questions I want the manager to answer live (short prompts):
- Bandwidth: "Can I reallocate 0.2 FTE from my current ops duties for 12 weeks?"
- Sponsorship: "Do you endorse me as primary owner for rollout communications to execs?"
- Budget: "Can we approve up to $12k for UX/contractor support to standardize templates?"

Objection handling scripts (one-liners):
- "We don’t have capacity": "I can scope a two-phase plan so phase 1 is low-lift and demonstrates ROI before we expand."
- "Not strategic right now": "The automation reduces ops toil and improves ramp time — those fold directly into hiring velocity which execs care about."

Staging notes (what I’ll share ahead of a sync if manager asks for pre-read):
- 1-pager metrics + 3 bullet asks (sponsorship, 0.2 reallocation, $12k)
- Pilot one-pager + raw survey highlights
- Runbook index with owner matrix and handoff checklist

Follow-ups and TODOs (actionable items I’ll track after the 1:1):
- Attach pilot survey export to Confluence and link in the pre-read (Due: +2 days)
- Draft sponsor-facing email for exec comms (Due: +4 days)
- Scope 2-phase rollout plan with clear acceptance metrics (Due: +1 week)
- Confirm mentor plan for the two ICs (Due: +2 weeks)

Random scratch/fragments (notes to self):
- Add anecdote about Jenna’s manager comment (made the case emotionally)
- Keep chart of median vs mean setup time — median hides tail, bring both
- Re-run SRE ticket filter to include closed in last 180d
- Try a 3-min video instead of long doc for execs

Meeting prep checklist (5–10 min last-minute):
- Open the 1-pager, rehearse 2 lines for opener, have metric lines memorized, prepare fallback ask.
- Have the survey pdf + runbook link in chat ready to paste.

Unresolved:
- Do we want to propose a formal title tweak (onboarding lead -> onboarding platform lead) as part of scope expansion? Save for calibration.

End: keep this doc minimal, copy/paste into quick Slack thread to prime manager if needed.

-- Noelle

(Version note: iterative working doc; will trim into 1-pager after manager alignment)
